title: Accelerating Distributed Deep Learning using Multi-Path RDMA in Data Center Networks
authors: Feng Tian; Yang Zhang; Wei Ye; Cheng Jin; Ziyan Wu; Zhi-Li Zhang
venue_full: ACM SIGCOMM Symposium on Software Defined Networking Research

problem_statement.en: Standard RDMA is a point-to-point transport mechanism that cannot utilize the rich multi-path topology of modern data center networks, leading to congestion and sub-optimal performance for distributed deep learning workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 標準 RDMA 屬於點對點傳輸機制，無法利用現代資料中心網路豐富的多路徑拓撲，導致分散式深度學習工作負載面臨壅塞與效能不佳的問題。

key_innovation.en: Maestro, a purely software-based multi-path RDMA middleware that uses virtual NICs (vNICs) to enable path control, message decomposition into chunks, and flexible, application-aware load balancing without modifying existing RDMA hardware.
key_innovation.zh: Maestro 是一套純軟體的多路徑 RDMA 中介層，藉由虛擬 NIC（vNICs）實現路徑控制、訊息分塊，以及彈性的應用感知負載均衡，無需修改現有 RDMA 硬體。

key_improvements.en: Up to 66.7% reduction in transport time for DDL applications and effective bandwidth aggregation with negligible CPU overhead.
key_improvements.zh: 分散式深度學習應用的傳輸時間最高降低 66.7%，並在幾乎不增加 CPU 額外負擔的情況下實現有效頻寬聚合。

ai_task: Distributed Deep Learning, Model Synchronization, Collective Communication
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, Elephant flows, Mice flows, Ring-AllReduce
compute_memory_hw: Xeon E5-2620v3, DDR4, Mellanox ConnectX-5, Mellanox ConnectX-3 Pro
